title: KubeSBS: A Reproducible Measurement Framework for Kubernetes Cluster Simulators (reproduction package)
description:
Reproduction package of the paper KubeSBS: A Reproducible Measurement Framework for Kubernetes Cluster Simulators. It contains a frozen copy of KubeSBS v0.4.0 (the framework, its datasets and the per-tool modules); the captured results of every experiment in the paper: the cost of six Kubernetes cluster simulators (KWOK, Kubemark, SimKube, the Kubernetes Scheduler Simulator, OpenSimulator and kcs) on an Alibaba-derived workload from 100 to 1,200 nodes in two sessions four months apart, a small-scale comparison with vanilla Kubernetes, and a fidelity study of KWOK against a real k3s cluster of 10 to 100 nodes on two hosts; and a Docker environment that regenerates every data figure and table of the paper and checks the tables against the published ones. REPRODUCE.md explains how to re-run the experiments.

This work has been granted by the Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades (MICIU) AEI/10.13039/501100011033 under contract PID2023-146193OB-I00.
